name: Kavar Dune
seed: To make every caravan purchase his water certificates.
design: Fennec, pale fur, huge ears, cream robe with narrow gold edging and dark teal gloves.
history: An Ossara pump trader who acquired wells during successive dry seasons.
desire: To make every caravan purchase his water certificates.
contradiction: Frames dependence as efficient planning and cannot tolerate a public supply that he does not control.
relationships: Veyra trades with him; Maela challenges him; Corvin offers outside contracts.
arc: His fabricated debt is exposed, but removing him does not refill the aquifer. He may surrender equipment or destroy his standing further.
story_engine: A generous water donation hides a binding claim; a desert storm strands him with people denied his service.
writer_truth: He ordered a viable competing pump kept closed and falsified the maintenance account.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
